rule: Use development layouts equally. Promote mask-first over B for this surface comparison if mean layout F1 or correctly assigned eligible pixel fraction improves by at least 2 points, the other falls by no more than 2 points, and opening fill increases by at most 1 point. Each line alternative must meet the same rule against mask-first. Among passing methods take highest mean layout F1 then pixel accuracy; prefer mask-first on ties. Ordinary builds also require demonstrated correct metric block placement.
